title: Accelerated Convergence of a Second-Order Dynamical System and its Application to Splitting Algorithms for Comonotone Inclusions
summary: This paper introduces a novel second-order dynamical system driven by a forward-backward splitting operator for solving the structured inclusion $0\in(A+B)(x)$ in a real Hilbert space, where $A$ is a maximal $ρ$-comonotone operator and $B$ is a $ν$-cocoercive operator. The well-posedness of the system is established, and Lyapunov analysis yields accelerated convergence rates of order $o(\frac{1}{t})$ for the velocity and $o(\frac{1}{t^2})$ for the forward-backward residual, together with weak convergence of the trajectories to $\operatorname{zer}(A+B)$.
